scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: SEEDS: Preview-Guided Evidence Admission for Search Agents
papers.authors: Jiajin Liu, Chenxi Xu, Dongzhe Fan, Yuanfu Sun, Qiaoyu Tan
papers.abstract: Search agents extend large reasoning models with multi-round access to external knowledge, yet most existing systems largely conflate retrieving evidence with consuming it. Retrieved documents are commonly incorporated according to fixed or rank-based policies, despite the fact that evidence utility is conditioned on the agent's current reasoning state. Consequently, a lower-ranked candidate may be critical for the current step, while a higher-ranked candidate may provide redundant, irrelevant, or misleading information. We formulate this overlooked problem as evidence admission, which asks, at each search step, which retrieved candidates should be allowed to enter the agent's evolving reasoning context. To enable such selective control, we introduce SEEDS (Selective Evidence Entry During Search), a preview-guided evidence admission framework for search agents. SEEDS first exposes lightweight previews of retrieved candidates and then lets the agent jointly determine which candidates and how many should be fully inspected, conditioned on its current reasoning state. Unlike fixed or adaptive prefix policies, SEEDS can select arbitrary subsets with flexible cardinality, and it can be instantiated directly with an existing reasoning agent or further optimized through learning. Across nine knowledge-intensive QA benchmarks under both local corpus and live web search, SEEDS consistently improves search effectiveness while substantially reducing full-evidence consumption. Experimental analyses show that SEEDS more effectively selects useful candidates beyond the corresponding retrieval prefix. These results establish evidence admission as a complementary dimension of agentic search, separating what information is retrieved from what information is ultimately allowed to shape reasoning.
papers.selection_reason: 匹配搜索Agent或工具调用，已核对原文证据
papers.summary: SEEDS 将证据准入独立于召回：先展示轻量预览，再由智能体根据当前推理状态选择任意子集，而非固定读取前几条。论文覆盖9个问答基准；Search-o1接入后，本地平均全文阅读数从30.2降至12.6，在线搜索准确率从9.28升至11.78，页面阅读数从27.81降至8.30。
papers.key_insight: UGC搜索中的高排名帖子不一定包含当前推理步骤需要的证据，可在召回后增加预览选择层，允许保留低排名但补充关键信息的帖子。应同时记录答案正确率、全文读取量和预览开销，并以固定前缀与自适应前缀作对照，检验收益是否来自更好的证据组合。

papers.title: Locate, Judge, Read: Role-Specialized Tool Agents over a Knowledge-Point Index for Open-Domain Multimodal Document QA
papers.abstract: Question answering over large heterogeneous document collections requires first finding the right passages and then reading them, yet current retrieval-augmented agents give one model both kinds of tools and let it schedule itself. We present KnowForge, a pipeline separated by job: a hybrid-retrieval knowledge-point index; a Locator agent that can only search; a code-scheduled bridge judge that forces the missing second hop; a typed, size-bounded evidence pool that merges every search's ranking; a Deep Reader agent that can only read text, images and tables; and a synthesizer with a format checker. With a self-hosted Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (3B active), KnowForge reaches F1 47.5 on the full open-domain M3DocVQA (2,441 questions, 3,368 PDFs), +11.0 over the published M3DocRAG system and +7.1 over one-shot retrieve-and-answer on the same index and model, and 53.5 with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. On MultiHop-RAG it reaches 73.5 accuracy, above the strongest published RAG and GraphRAG results (71.2); on the single-document MMLongBench-Doc it lifts the same model from 34.8 to 47.0, level with GPT-4o reading page images (46.3). Per-job ablations on the full benchmarks attribute the gain: the Deep Reader is worth 3.8, 9.8 and 0 points on the three corpora, tracking how visual each is; merging both agents into one with all tools and twice the rounds loses 1.9 F1 because it keeps searching instead of reading; a round-budget sweep shows a step at four Locator rounds and a plateau beyond; query latency scales with model calls rather than corpus size. We serve the three indexed benchmarks as read-only knowledge bases (free registration) and release all prompts and the runner code: this https URL

papers.summary: KnowForge 将定位、补跳、阅读与答案生成拆成工具互斥的工作阶段，解决智能体持续搜索却不读取表格和图像的问题。在包含2441个问题、3368份PDF的M3DocVQA上，F1达到47.5，比同索引同模型的单轮基线高7.1点；MultiHop-RAG准确率为73.5。
papers.key_insight: 社区UGC复杂问答可先尝试只负责检索的定位器和固定的补跳检查，再按内容类型决定是否调用阅读器。论文在纯文本新闻集上发现去掉阅读器仍达74.1，说明不应机械增加角色；先用同模型消融确认收益，再评估多轮推理对搜索延迟的影响。

papers.title: Web$hell: A Unified Interface for Agentic Web Access
papers.authors: Sunghwan Kim, Deogyong Kim, Sangam Lee, Donguk Kwon, Dongha Lee
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are becoming direct users of the open web. As they take on increasingly complex and information-intensive tasks, effective web access is becoming a core capability for agentic problem solving. Existing approaches have advanced agentic web access through different access models, including search-augmented agents, browser-based agents, and, more recently, filesystem-based agents. Nevertheless, as users expect agents to complete long-horizon, end-to-end tasks, they increasingly need to conduct broad information gathering, perform browser actions, and revisit acquired evidence within a single trajectory. Yet our preliminary analyses reveal that existing access models struggle to meet these demands. They primarily support either information gathering or browser interaction, while combining their capabilities can involve substantial costs or performance trade-offs. To this end, we present Web\$hell, an interface that unifies web access under a single access model. Using a common schema defined by WebContract, WebCompiler compiles live webpages into addressable information and action objects. These objects are maintained in WebCache and handled through a shared set of operations, providing agents with consistent, operable, and persistent web access. Through extensive experiments across web search, web navigation, and deep research benchmarks, we show that Web\$hell achieves strong task performance at lower cost. Our results further indicate the importance of interface design for effective web access, with Web\$hell opening new possibilities for more capable and efficient LLM agents on the web.
papers.selection_reason: 匹配搜索Agent或工具调用，已核对原文证据
papers.summary: Web$hell 用WebContract统一页面信息与动作对象，WebCompiler编译网页，WebCache保存可寻址证据，减少跨表示重复读取。在WideSearch上Item F1为0.782，对比最强基线0.745；WebArena-Verified成功率为0.679，DeepWeb-Bench得分31.11，对比混合接口28.37。

papers.title: RATED: Reliability-Aware AI Agent Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics
papers.abstract: As AI agents increasingly rely on external tools, accurate retrieval is essential for reliable behavior. Existing methods optimize semantic relevance but largely ignore tool availability during execution. To address this gap, we propose RATED (Reliability-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics), a retrieval framework that combines robust semantic matching with dynamic reliability adaptation. RATED employs a frozen dual-encoder with contrastive fine-tuning for semantic matching, and a lightweight contextual bandit module that re-ranks candidates based on real-time execution feedback. This design enables rapid adaptation to runtime tool failures without expensive model retraining. We introduce EcoAgent, a benchmark of 5,172 real-world tools and over 210,000 query-tool pairs for offline retrieval and dynamic reliability evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that RATED achieves a 52.2% relative MRR improvement over the ToolLLM API retriever on real-world queries, and reduces fault selection rate from 86.2% to 2.9% under severe API outage scenarios with a 30% failure rate, while incurring negligible latency overhead of less than 1 ms over encode-only inference. The code and dataset are available at this https URL .
papers.selection_reason: 匹配搜索Agent或工具调用，已核对原文证据
papers.summary: RATED 在语义工具检索后加入轻量上下文老虎机，利用执行反馈重排工具，避免选到语义匹配但不可用的API。EcoAgent包含5172个工具和超过21万查询工具对；真实查询MRR较ToolLLM检索器相对提高52.2%，30%工具故障场景下故障选择率从86.2%降至2.9%，新增开销低于1毫秒。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索Agent经常依赖搜索、详情读取与外部知识接口，可把可用性反馈加入工具路由，避免反复调用故障服务。建议区分网络失败、权限拒绝和语义不适配，并保留探索概率及冷启动策略；论文的故障模拟结果不能直接解释为线上nDCG或CTR提升。

papers.title: Reflective Prompt Optimization of a Deep-Research Agent: A Topic-Disjoint, Multi-Seed Protocol for Measuring Transferable Gains and Prompt-Level Overfitting
papers.authors: Elias Lumer, Sahil Sen, Vamse Kumar Subbiah, Kevin Paul
papers.abstract: Prompt optimization is an attractive alternative to reinforcement learning for adapting language-model agents, since it is cheap and produces human-readable artifacts. On factual tasks, however, it carries a failure mode that scalar-reward reinforcement learning does not. An optimizer that reads the training examples can write their answers into the prompt, so an in-distribution gain may be memorization rather than transferable behaviour. We apply reflective prompt evolution (GEPA) to the two system prompts of a multi-agent deep-research agent and evaluate it under a topic-disjoint split in which no topic is shared across train, validation, and test. Held-out citation reward rises by 0.079, from 0.702 to 0.781, with a bootstrap 95\% confidence interval of [0.051, 0.107], and the gain replicates across three seeds (mean 0.107). Nearly half of the winning prompt is a memorized answer key, yet a controlled ablation shows this content earns no reward even on the exact training questions it encodes. The large validation-minus-held-out gap is therefore small-sample selection under a noisy judge, not memorization. Varying the verifier isolates what makes the gain transfer. Decomposed per-dimension feedback is the causal ingredient, and collapsing it to a single scalar reward makes held-out transfer negative. The gain persists under an out-of-family judge and is largely reproduced by a hand-written version of the discovered recipe. Credible evaluation of prompt optimizers therefore requires held-out topics, multiple seeds, and verifier ablations. We release the candidate prompts, lineage diffs, figures, tables, and analysis.
papers.selection_reason: 匹配搜索Agent或工具调用，已核对原文证据
papers.summary: 论文用GEPA优化深度研究Agent的两个系统提示，并采用主题隔离与多随机种子评估，检查提示优化是否真的迁移。留出集引用奖励从0.702升至0.781，95%置信区间为[0.051,0.107]；3个种子平均收益0.107。消融表明分维度反馈关键，合成单一标量奖励后迁移变为负值。
papers.key_insight: 社区问答Agent的提示迭代可按话题划分训练与留出集，避免同一事件或答案跨集合泄漏。将引用正确性、证据覆盖和回答完整性分别反馈，比单一总体分数更便于定位错误；还要更换评审模型和进行多种子重复，防止小样本选优被误当成泛化提升。

papers.title: Beyond Outcome Rewards: Step-Level Self-Distilled Policy Optimization for Deep Search Agents
papers.abstract: Deep search agents operate over trajectories spanning dozens of steps, yet standard reinforcement learning provides only a single outcome reward per trajectory, which is far too sparse for effective credit assignment. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) addresses this by using the model's own logits as dense token-level teachers, but extending it to search agents introduces a fundamental tension: the teacher, having access to privileged information such as the correct answer, produces a distribution that differs systematically from the student's exploration-based reasoning, and naive distillation causes the student to inherit this information asymmetry rather than learn better search strategies. We resolve this tension through two contributions. First, we construct Evidence Anchors, which are concise, step-level evidence snippets extracted from the web, as privileged information that captures key reasoning steps without revealing the entire answer path. Second, we propose Step-Level Self-Distilled Policy Optimization (SSPO), which converts teacher-student disagreement into step-level advantage weights within GRPO, applied exclusively to incorrect trajectories. This design decouples what to update from how much to update: the outcome reward determines the direction of policy change, while the teacher modulates its magnitude at each step. Correct trajectories are left untouched, preserving their diversity. On Qwen3-8B, SSPO consistently outperforms GRPO across BrowseComp, GAIA, and FRAMES, surpassing or matching GRPO trained with twice as many gradient steps while adding only about 5 percent overhead per step from a single additional forward pass.
papers.selection_reason: 匹配搜索Agent或工具调用，已核对原文证据
papers.summary: SSPO 面向数十步深度搜索轨迹的稀疏奖励问题，从网页抽取步骤级Evidence Anchors，并将教师学生分歧转为GRPO的步骤优势权重，只更新错误轨迹。Qwen3-8B在BrowseComp、GAIA和FRAMES上超过或达到训练步数翻倍的GRPO；每步增加一次前向计算，开销约5%。
papers.key_insight: 社区复杂查询的RL训练可按步骤提供证据锚点，避免教师直接暴露答案而让学生学到不可用信息。可先复现正确轨迹不更新与错误步骤加权的消融，再验证检索调用质量。该工作发表于8月，属于90天内补充材料，且需训练基础设施，适合研究试验而非直接替换线上排序。

papers.title: SPARQL-LLM in the TEXT2SPARQL 2026 Challenge
papers.authors: Panayiotis Smeros, Vincent Emonet, Ruijie Wang, Ana-Claudia Sima, Tarcisio Mendes de Farias
papers.abstract: Querying distributed data represented as Knowledge Graphs (KGs) via SPARQL remains a difficult task, requiring fluency in query syntax, endpoint specifications, and schema details. Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA) systems address this by automatically translating natural language into SPARQL, and recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have made this translation increasingly feasible. In this paper, we describe SPARQL-LLM, our open-source KGQA system, in the context of the TEXT2SPARQL 2026 challenge. In this challenge, SPARQL-LLM ranks first overall among eight competing approaches across all datasets, achieving up to 59% higher accuracy than the second-best approach and supporting multilingual question answering in English, German, and Spanish. SPARQL-LLM is publicly released at this https URL and deployed in production over decentralized bioinformatics KGs at this https URL .
papers.selection_reason: 匹配搜索Agent或工具调用，已核对原文证据
papers.summary: SPARQL-LLM 描述自然语言访问分布式知识图谱的开源系统，减少用户理解查询语法、端点与模式的负担。在TEXT2SPARQL 2026中，系统在8个参赛方法中总体排名第一，准确率相较第二名最高提高59%，支持英语、德语和西班牙语，并已用于分布式生物信息图谱。
papers.key_insight: 社区问答如果涉及结构化实体与关系，可借鉴自然语言到查询工具的接入方式，让生成结果由图谱执行返回证据。它主要解决KGQA而非普通帖子召回，因此应只用于结构化知识分支；先验证查询执行率、答案准确率及越权访问边界，再决定是否纳入Agent工具集合。

papers.title: When Charts Deceive Web Agents: A Paired Benchmark for Misleading Visualization-Grounded Tasks
papers.authors: Yisheng Li, Dongming Han, Hongkun Pan, Bingcheng Mao, Zijian Wang, Yunlong Mao, Wei Tong, Sheng Zhong
papers.abstract: Web agents increasingly browse, interpret, and act on web content on behalf of users. In many realistic workflows, however, the visual evidence they consume is not neutral: charts and dashboards can be misleading, shaping judgments without issuing any explicit malicious instruction. Unlike chart question answering, Web Agents treat charts as intermediate evidence whose misinterpretation can propagate into concrete downstream actions --- a reliability risk that remains underexplored. We introduce MisVisAgentBench, the first paired executable benchmark for evaluating how misleading visualizations affect Web Agent execution. It comprises 280 task instances in matched clean--misleading pairs that differ only in chart evidence. We further provide a diagnostic framework that isolates misleading-induced failures from baseline task difficulty (Zhu et al., 2025) and captures execution-level effects such as extra browsing steps and decision hesitation. Across thirteen vision-language Web Agents, replacing clean charts with misleading counterparts reduces the average task success rate by more than 34 percentage points. Moreover, these failures predominantly follow the targeted misleading action branch, suggesting that deceptive charts systematically redirect rather than randomly disrupt agent decisions. These results reveal that visualization robustness is a critical yet understudied dimension of Web Agent safety and reliability.
papers.selection_reason: 匹配搜索Agent或工具调用，已核对原文证据
papers.summary: MisVisAgentBench 用成对的正常与误导图表测试网页Agent，配对任务只改变图表证据，便于隔离视觉误导影响。基准包含280个任务实例并评估13个视觉语言Agent；误导图表使平均任务成功率下降超过34个百分点，失败主要沿预设误导分支发生，而非随机扰动。
papers.key_insight: UGC搜索回答如果引用用户上传的统计截图，不能仅依赖图表视觉结论。可用相同问题的正常与误导版本做配对测试，检查坐标截断、比例失真对最终答案的影响，并要求回溯原始数值。该基准测量网页执行可靠性，迁移到搜索需另建引用与事实核查指标。

papers.title: Can Language Models Play the Wikipedia Game?
papers.authors: Alexander Hickey, Joanna Knight, James Bishop
papers.abstract: Language models increasingly support or automate information retrieval from document collections too large to index. This task is difficult when it requires specialist linguistic or scientific knowledge. We used the Wikipedia Game to test language models on an analogous information retrieval task. In the game, players must reach a target article using only article links. We compared sentence embedding models and LLMs across five Wikipedia languages and five academic-literature datasets. We construct very large local graphs of Wikipedia pages and of paper citations using OpenAlex and provide code to build and navigate them. This allows the study of language models' navigation capabilities without relying on third-party APIs. We compared the models with human and TF-IDF benchmarks. The Wikipedia Game format enables robust comparisons across techniques, languages, and domains. No model significantly outperformed humans, although the best models (GPT-o3 mini, GPT-4o, QwQ:32B, and DeepSeek-R1:70B) achieved comparable success. Performance and rankings varied across languages and topics, with implications for practitioners utilising these techniques.
papers.selection_reason: 匹配搜索Agent或工具调用，已核对原文证据
papers.summary: 论文把Wikipedia Game用于评估模型在无法完整索引的集合中逐步导航：只能沿文章链接到目标页面。作者比较5种维基语言和5个学术文献集合，并提供基于OpenAlex的本地图构建代码；最佳模型达到接近人类的成功水平，但没有模型显著超过人类，排名随语言和主题变化。
papers.key_insight: 社区内容中的引用、相关帖子与用户关系也可形成导航图，适合用来测试搜索Agent是否能跨多步找到目标证据。应把导航成功率和路径长度与传统检索基线同时报告，并分话题、语言统计；这项研究提供跨域评测设计，尚未证明能提高社区搜索点击率。
